svg.aria-label: Prevention and control of diabetes mellitus
svg.text: Levels of prevention · diet · "no cure, but controlled" philosophy

g.text: Population: primordial (prevent risk-factor emergence) · keep normal weight · high dietary fibre · avoid sweet foods
High-risk: avoid sedentary life, over-nutrition, obesity & alcohol · avoid diabetogenic drugs (OCP)
Adequate treatment · periodic blood sugar, urine protein & ketones, BP, visual acuity, weight
HbA1c at half-yearly intervals · self-care with medical guidance
Specialised diabetic clinics/units for complications — blindness, kidney failure, coronary thrombosis, gangrene

svg.text: 🍞 CHO 45–60% · 🧈 fat <35% (sat <10%) · 🥚 protein 10–15% · 🥗 fruit/veg 5 portions · 🧂 salt ≤6 g (<3 g if hypertensive)
Weight control + exercise ~30 min daily · low-calorie sweeteners · alcohol moderate
🔒 "DM cannot be fully cured, but can be controlled" — why?
No cure: Type-1 → irreversible autoimmune β-cell destruction (lifelong insulin) · Type-2 → progressive insulin resistance
Controlled: targets HbA1c <7% · fasting 80–130 mg/dL · post-prandial <180 · BP <130/80 · LDL <100 → near-normal life
